groups.activity: pledge Cephalon Suda, earn standing from mission affinity and Syndicate Medallions
groups.meta: 365,000 standing total to Genius plus the hammer
groups.mode: leave around round 8 for one clean daily cap

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 2 at Rank 4 Wise, 3 at Rank 5 Genius

conditions: Daily standing cap is 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, shared across every faction syndicate, resetting 00:00 UTC.
Pledging Suda costs New Loka 100% and Red Veil 50% of every gain; either at -2 sends death squads and locks its shop.
Rank-ups also cost 940,000 credits in total. Rank up as soon as you can afford it; standing past a rank's maximum is wasted.
bonuses: The three daily Suda Syndicate Alerts (from Rank 1) and their Datum medallions (8 per alert, roughly 10,000 standing) ignore the daily cap. Loot radar shows medallions on the minimap.
Suda feeds Arbiters of Hexis at +50%; pledging Steel Meridian afterwards costs neither.

disclosures.title: why 365,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to Genius (5,000 / 22,000 / 44,000 / 70,000 / 99,000). The 125,000-standing purchase is then farmed on top; Genius's bar holds 132,000, enough to bank it.

disclosures.title: alerts that don't pay
disclosures.body: Defense and Interception Suda alerts spawn only 0-2 medallions unless they're on a Grineer Sealab or Galleon tileset.

conditions: The free item you pick at Genius can never be a Syndicate weapon; the Heliocor is always a separate 125,000-standing purchase.
Mastery Rank 11 is required both to buy it and to receive it in a trade.
bonuses: It's a separate Mastery entry from the base Heliocor (Cephalon Simaris), and Synoid Gammacor sells from the same Genius rank.

disclosures.title: for Kavat codes, bring the base Heliocor
disclosures.body: Only a direct hammer kill scans; DoT kills don't. The Synoid's high status lets DoTs take the kill, so the crit-leaning base Heliocor scans more reliably.
